spans.s:
n. (-र्म्म्यं)
Paraphymosis, circumcision.
E.
दुश्चर्म्म, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sprung of a bad or low family or race.
E.
दुष्कुल of a bad race, affix ढक्; also दुष्कुलीन.

n. (-वं)
Badness, wickedness.
E.
दुष्ठ, and अण् aff.

m. (-न्तिः)
A name of BHARAT, the first sole monarch of India.
E.
दुष्मन्त DUṢMANTA, husband of ŚAKUNTALĀ, and father to BHARATA, इञ् affix of descent; it is perhaps preferably read दौष्यन्ति from दुष्यन्त.
